caption: The Shopify plan screen of the app, scrolled down: the end of the Free plan card with a Select button and the list 10 posts/month, 10 images/month, 1 workflow and Basic SEO, then the heading Unavailable on dev stores with the text These plans can't be selected while the store is in development, and three greyed out cards, Starter $9 / 30 days (30 posts/month, 30 images/month, 3 workflows, Brand voices, Auto-publish, Expert SEO), Pro $29 / 30 days (100 posts/month, 100 images/month, 10 workflows, Product references, Priority generation, All Starter features) and Business $79 / 30 days (300 posts/month, 300 images/month, 30 workflows, All Pro features, Priority support), each with a greyed out button Not available. The store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The generated post in the editor of the app: the title How to choose a snowboard for beginners, a button Publish to Shopify, the status Draft, an editor with the heading How to Choose Your First Snowboard (and Avoid Bad Advice) and the first paragraphs, a generated featured image of snowboards with an empty Alt text field, and the box Content quality with the score 95/100. The store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden; the chat button at the bottom right is a generic icon.

The right-hand part of the same post: the box Content quality 95/100 with the checks Content Length 1500 words, SEO Title Length 53 characters, Meta Description 153 characters, Heading Structure 5 H2 and 6 H3 headings, URL Handle (a warning mark, URL is set and reasonably concise), Readability Flesch 83/100, AI tells No common AI filler phrases detected, Sentence rhythm and Active voice 2% passive sentences; the Excerpt field, the closed boxes AI Improve and Version History (1), and the start of SEO Metadata. The store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The Settings page of the app on the Free plan: the box Generation quality with a Ground generation with Google Search checkbox (not ticked), the box Article navigation with an In this article checkbox (not ticked) and a Save changes button, and the box Brand voices with 1 voice, Test voice (professional), a New voice button and the links Edit and Delete. The store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.
